result.topic_en: A high-precision computation (the first of two) of A = e^{-π/4}, made by writing 2489A as a near-integer 113483/100 times e^δ, with δ obtained from Wolfram's logarithm tables and e^δ from its power series.

methods.what: Choosing a multiplier (2489 = 19·131) so that 2489·A is extremely close to a rational number with small denominator, reducing the computation to a tiny correction δ
methods.quote:
so war $19.131 A$ oder $2489 A$ [-äusserst genau-] $=$
$1134,8300000095$ oder $248900 A$ sehr genau $= 113483$

methods.what: Factorization of 113483 and its representations by the quadratic form x^2+58y^2
Expressing 2489A as N·e^δ, with δ computed from natural logarithms of the factors
Splitting δ by subtracting log(1+0.…8428), leaving a smaller remainder δ'
Exponential power series e^{δ'} = 1 + δ' + δ'^2/2 + δ'^3/6 applied to the small remainder

items.quote:
Da man durch eine schon vorher angestellte Rechnung wusste
dass der Werth von A bis auf die letzte Zifer
$0,4559381277\ 6599$ sei
items.english: Since one already knew from a computation made earlier that the value of A, to the last digit, is 0.45593812776599
